scenarios.name: relay/go-client-rust-relay
scenarios.description: A Go client authenticates to an upstream Rust relay and exchanges ping and pong frames, and a pass proves compatible relay protocol negotiation and framing.

scenarios.name: relay/rust-client-go-relay
scenarios.description: The Rust test driver authenticates to a Go relay and exchanges ping and pong frames, and a pass proves that the Go relay accepts the upstream wire protocol.

scenarios.name: relay/rust-client-rust-relay
scenarios.description: The Rust test driver authenticates to an upstream Rust relay and exchanges ping and pong frames, and a pass proves that the pinned control path is operational.

scenarios.name: relay/websocket-upgrade
scenarios.description: A Go client performs the authenticated WebSocket upgrade against an upstream Rust relay, and a pass proves compatible HTTP upgrade and relay session setup.

scenarios.name: relay/ping-pong
scenarios.description: A Go client sends an eight-byte relay ping to an upstream Rust relay, and a pass proves that the corresponding pong preserves the payload.

scenarios.name: relay/idle-timeout
scenarios.description: A client leaves a TCP connection idle before WebSocket establishment on an upstream Rust relay, and a pass proves that the relay closes it after the expected timeout.
